topic: Explanation of stability and control augmentation system, attitude base stabilization system.
syllabus_extract: Explanation of stability and control augmentation system, attitude base stabilization system.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of AFCS block diagrams and signal flow charts from IB; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the AFCS?
Define stability augmentation in the context of rotorcraft.
List two types of control augmentation systems.

development.content:
Definition of Stability Augmentation System
Purpose of reducing pilot workload
Basic components of SAS
Sensor inputs for SAS
Actuator response mechanisms

Attitude Based Stabilization System principles
Pitch and roll axis stabilization
Yaw rate damping functions
Integration with main autopilot
Fail-safe modes and reversion

topics: Comparison of SAS and ABS systems
development.content:
Comparison of SAS and ABS systems
Operational benefits of AFCS
Limitations of augmentation systems
Maintenance implications
Transition to next lesson topics

summary_questions: Explain how the AFCS improves helicopter handling qualities.
Describe the difference between stability augmentation and attitude stabilization.
Identify the primary sensors used in an attitude-based stabilization system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the facilities available through the helicopter autopilot system as covered in LP 42, focusing on how it extends the capabilities of the AFCS.
